section: Bretton Woods institutions - IMF (quota, SDR), World Bank Group; ADB, AIIB, NDB

accepted.s: The Asian Development Bank was established in which year?
accepted.x: The Asian Development Bank was established in 1966.
accepted.tq: Use the direct year-recall approach and distinguish nearby dates.

accepted.s: The headquarters of the Asian Development Bank is located at
accepted.x: The headquarters of the Asian Development Bank is in Manila, Philippines.
accepted.tq: Test the headquarters-location fact directly.

accepted.s: The Asian Development Bank was created at the initiative of which organisation?
accepted.x: The Asian Development Bank was created at the initiative of the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UN-ESCAP).
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-origin trap by distinguishing related United Nations bodies.

accepted.s:
With reference to India and the Asian Development Bank, consider the following statements:
1. India was a founding member of the Asian Development Bank.
2. India holds a voting share of 6.3 per cent in the Asian Development Bank.
3. India has a higher voting share than China in the Asian Development Bank.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: India was a founding member and has a 6.3 per cent voting share. Since China's share is 6.4 per cent, India does not have a higher share than China; therefore statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Compare the exact percentages and identify the reversed-comparison trap.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs relating to voting shares in the Asian Development Bank:

Shareholder — Voting share
1. Japan — 15.7%
2. United States of America — 15.7%
3. China — 6.4%
4. India — 6.3%

Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Japan and the United States each hold 15.7 per cent, China holds 6.4 per cent and India holds 6.3 per cent.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical pair separately before selecting the combined code.

accepted.s: As of 2025, the Asian Development Bank had how many members, comprising how many Asia-Pacific and non-regional members respectively?
accepted.x: The Asian Development Bank had 69 members: 49 from the Asia-Pacific region and 20 non-regional members.
accepted.tq: Match the total with its exact component numbers.

accepted.s: Which one of the following countries was the newest member of the Asian Development Bank in 2025?
accepted.x: Türkiye was the newest member of the Asian Development Bank in 2025.
accepted.tq: Test the newest-member fact against established member countries.

accepted.s: In December 2025, the Asian Development Bank raised India's FY26 growth forecast from 6.5 per cent to
accepted.x: The Asian Development Bank raised India's FY26 growth forecast to 7.2 per cent from 6.5 per cent in December 2025.
accepted.tq: Read the revised figure together with the original baseline.

accepted.s: The Articles of Agreement of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank were signed in which year?
accepted.x: The Articles of Agreement of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank were signed in 2015.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the signing year from the year of commencement of operations.

accepted.s: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank commenced its operations in
accepted.x: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank began operations in January 2016.
accepted.tq: Use the precise month-year combination rather than the nearby Articles-signing year.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank?
o: It is headquartered in Beijing, China, with India as its largest shareholder and China as its second-largest shareholder.
It is headquartered in Beijing, China, with China as its largest shareholder and India as its second-largest shareholder.
It is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with Japan as its largest shareholder and India as its second-largest shareholder.
It is headquartered in Manila, Philippines, with India as its largest shareholder and China as its second-largest shareholder.
accepted.x: The AIIB is headquartered in Beijing. China is its largest shareholder and India is its second-largest shareholder.
accepted.tq: Separate headquarters, largest shareholder and second-largest shareholder instead of swapping their relationships.

accepted.s: According to the stated September 2026 position, which of the following correctly represents the AIIB's scale and rating?
o: 120 approved members, approximately 70 billion dollars across 350 projects, and an AAA rating
111 approved members, approximately 59 billion dollars across 300 projects, and an AAA rating
111 approved members, approximately 69 billion dollars across 350 projects, and an AAA rating
110 approved members, approximately 69 billion dollars across 350 projects, and an AA rating
accepted.x: The AIIB had 111 approved members, approximately 69 billion dollars committed across 350 projects, and an AAA rating.
accepted.tq: Verify all components of a compound numerical description.

accepted.s:
Which of the following projects are co-funded by the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank?
1. Mumbai MUTP-III
2. NIIF Phase II
3. Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor
4. AP Disaster Recovery Project
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The AIIB co-funds Mumbai MUTP-III and NIIF Phase II. The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is identified with ADB, while the AP Disaster Recovery Project is identified with the World Bank.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct lender by eliminating projects assigned to neighbouring institutions.

accepted.s:
The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor in Andhra Pradesh is associated with which of the following descriptions?
1. It includes the nodes of Visakhapatnam, Chittoor and Kopparthy.
2. It covers 33,000 acres.
3. It is funded by an ADB loan of ₹3,300 crore in two tranches.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The VCIC includes the Visakhapatnam, Chittoor and Kopparthy nodes, covers 33,000 acres and receives an ADB loan of ₹3,300 crore in two tranches.
accepted.tq: Combine project geography, area and financing details without confusing the lender.

accepted.s: The AP Road Sector Project, associated with the World Bank, covers approximately how much of the road network comprising major district roads and State highways?
accepted.x: The AP Road Sector Project covers 850 km of major district roads and State highways and is associated with the World Bank.
accepted.tq: Test the exact project coverage figure and avoid nearby rounded values.

accepted.s: The AP Disaster Recovery Project funded by the World Bank was associated with recovery after
accepted.x: The AP Disaster Recovery Project was associated with post-Hudhud recovery.
accepted.tq: Use the event-project linkage rather than the lender alone.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. VCIC — ADB
2. AP Road Sector Project — World Bank
3. AP Rural Roads Project — AIIB
4. AP Disaster Recovery Project — World Bank
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched: VCIC with ADB, the AP Road Sector Project with the World Bank, the AP Rural Roads Project with AIIB and the AP Disaster Recovery Project with the World Bank.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure lender-project pairs and verify the complete combination.

accepted.s: The 18th BRICS Summit New Delhi Declaration, referred to in the stated September 2026 context, sought reform of which institutions?
o: United Nations Security Council institutions only
accepted.x: The 18th BRICS Summit New Delhi Declaration sought reform of the Bretton Woods institutions.
accepted.tq: Link the declaration with its stated institutional reform agenda.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements best reflects the stated comparison between the New Development Bank and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank?
o: The New Development Bank's lending was described as slower than that of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.
The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank's lending was described as slower than that of the New Development Bank.
Both institutions were described as having identical lending speeds.
Neither institution was associated with infrastructure lending.
accepted.x: The stated comparison described the New Development Bank's lending as slow in contrast with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.
accepted.tq: Focus on the direction of the comparison and avoid reversing the two institutions.

accepted.s:
Which of the following have been identified as criticisms or areas of debate concerning Bretton Woods institutions?
1. Structural adjustment conditions
2. Sovereign immunity
3. Northern control of votes
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Structural adjustment conditions, sovereign immunity and Northern control of votes are all identified as criticisms or areas of debate concerning Bretton Woods institutions.
accepted.tq: Treat each listed criticism as an independent statement before choosing the combined code.
